name: 金庸群侠传（2015版）
english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2015 Edition)
english_description: A version compiled and released in 2015, part of the ES II engine series — sharing the same underlying engine/daemon code with this project's "2008 Enhanced" edition and its siblings. The engine itself changed little over those seven years; what changed was the content, with this edition adding a number of new areas and storylines beyond the 2008 release.
